title: Duane Arnold (NextEra restart): Memo from K. Conway, NRR, to S. Koenick, NRR - Meeting Summary of 10-5-26 between NRC and Flandreau Santee Sioux Tribe Regarding the Potential Reauthorization of Power Operations at Duane Arnold Energy Center [['Meeting Summary', 'Memoranda']]

SUBJECT:                     MEETING SUMMARY BETWEEN THE U.S. NUCLEAR
                             REGULATORY COMMISSION AND THE FLANDREAU SANTEE
                             SIOUX TRIBE REGARDING THE POTENTIAL
                             REAUTHORIZATION OF POWER OPERATIONS AT DUANE
                             ARNOLD ENERGY CENTER (EPID NUMBER: L-2025-LNE-0009)
                             (DOCKET NUMBER: 50-331)

On October 5, 2026, U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) staff held a virtual
informational meeting with the Assistant Tribal Historic Preservation Officer (THPO) for the
Flandreau Santee Sioux Tribe. The purpose of the meeting was to provide an overview of the
NRC’s National Environmental Policy Act of 1969, as amended (NEPA), and Section 106
National Historic Preservation Act of 1966, as amended (NHPA), review processes and final
determinations regarding the proposed reauthorization of power operations at Duane Arnold
Energy Center (DAEC) in Palo, Iowa. This staff-level information session offered the Tribal
representative an opportunity to discuss the submitted licensing and regulatory requests, the
NRC’s Section 106 analysis, determination, and findings, and to ask questions of NRC staff.
The meeting was not recorded, transcribed, or open to the public.


CONTACT:      Jennifer Davis, OAR/ARERB
              301-415-3835
 S. Koenick                                     -2-


The meeting began with introductions, followed by an overview of the NRC’s environmental
review and NHPA Section 106 process for the proposed DAEC restart project. As part of this
overview, the NRC staff described the defined area of potential effects (APE) for the Section
106 undertaking and summarized historic and cultural resource surveys conducted within the
APE since the issuance of the NRC’s 2010 supplemental environmental impact statement for
initial license renewal for DAEC (NUREG-1437, Supplement 42). The presentation also included
a review of historic aerial imagery and Iowa state LiDAR imaging for the DAEC site and
surrounding region. The meeting concluded with a timeline of next steps in the environmental
review and upcoming and future potential licensing actions at DAEC.

The Assistant THPO inquired about onsite waste management, historic and cultural resources
onsite and within a 6-mile radius of the DAEC site, and ecological information and surveys from
the Wickiup Hill Natural Area.

The meeting concluded with an acknowledgement that the Tribe would follow up with their
internal staff and the applicant (NextEra Energy Duane Arnold, LLC) and may have more
questions, concerns, or information to share at a future date. The NRC staff reiterated its
availability to answer questions and meet at any point during this review.
 S. Koenick                                     -3-
